settings.label: At a glance
settings.text: Smells like: cedar, smoke and a little suede. Grit: medium. Featuring: shea butter, coconut oil and sustainably sourced palm-free soap base.

settings.label: Ingredients
settings.text: Saponified coconut, olive and sunflower oils, shea butter, glycerin, essential oils and fragrance, ground pumice for the grit, and nothing from our no-go list. The full list is printed on every wrapper.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Wet the bar and your hands, work up a lather and rinse. Set it somewhere that drains so it dries between uses.

settings.heading: Three things a good bar does

settings.title: Moisture stays put
settings.text: Shea butter and sunflower oil cushion your skin so it does not feel tight after drying off.

settings.title: A lather that lasts
settings.text: The bar stays firm instead of melting into mush, so one lasts two to three weeks of daily showers.

settings.title: Scent with staying power
settings.text: Essential oils and plant-derived fragrance linger on skin well past your first coffee.

settings.image_alt: A man lathering his forearms at a sink
settings.heading: Notes on getting the most from your bar
settings.text: Start with a quick rinse, rub the bar between your palms and wash from the shoulders down. Rough patches like elbows and heels can take a second pass. Let the bar air dry afterward and it will keep its shape.

settings.heading: What we put in, what we leave out

settings.title: Mostly plants
settings.text: Ninety-eight percent of what is in the bar comes from natural origins.

settings.title: Nothing sketchy
settings.text: No aluminum, parabens, phthalates or synthetic dyes make it past the door.

settings.title: Made for men
settings.text: Scented, sized and scrubbed for the way guys really wash.

settings.label: What makes a cold-process bar different?
settings.text: It is mixed at a low temperature and cured for weeks, which keeps natural glycerin in the soap and leaves skin softer than a machine-milled bar.

settings.label: How long does one bar last?
settings.text: Used daily and kept dry, about two to three weeks.

settings.label: Is it okay for sensitive skin?
settings.text: Many customers with sensitive skin use it daily. If you react easily, start with the zero-grit moisture bar and patch-test first.

settings.label: Is it vegan?
settings.text: Most bars are plant-based, but a few limited editions may include beeswax or honey. Check the ingredient list on each page.

settings.label: How strong is the scent?
settings.text: Strong enough that you will smell it in the shower and faintly through the evening. It will not announce you from across the room.

settings.label: When will it arrive?
settings.text: Orders leave in one to two business days and take three to seven days to arrive within the United States.

settings.title: Smells like a lodge in the hills
settings.text: The scent is warm without being sweet. A week in, my towel still smells like it.
